# Aritro Shome (sortira)

> Personal site of Aritro Shome (a.k.a. sortira), a student engineer working across machine-learning research, ML engineering and systems. Research intern at AI4Bharat, IIT Madras, doing mechanistic interpretability and circuit tracing on multilingual vision-language models over Indic inputs; previously an AI engineer intern at Sarvam AI, building evaluation frameworks and production data pipelines. Also interested in core CS: distributed systems, database internals, concurrency and algorithms.

Canonical host: https://aritro.is-a.dev/ (https://sortira.github.io/ redirects here). Clean markdown mirrors of each page are linked below.

## Main

- [Home](https://aritro.is-a.dev/index.html.md): Positioning, current work at AI4Bharat, prior work at Sarvam AI, selected solo projects (ForgeFormer; Seven Deadly Sins of Gemma; AlponaGen) with tech stacks, education, awards, teaching.
- [Everything else](https://aritro.is-a.dev/other.html.md): Tooling (ML, infra, languages, core CS), smaller builds, certifications, earlier academic results.
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://aritro.is-a.dev/resume.pdf)

## Optional

- [ForgeFormer writeup](https://silicognition.is-a.dev/post2.html): Hand-designed interpretable 2-layer transformer that performs two-digit addition with manually-set weights and no gradient descent.
- [ForgeFormer demo](https://aritro.is-a.dev/forgeformer/): Interactive demo.
- [Seven Deadly Sins of Gemma writeup](https://silicognition.is-a.dev/post3.html): Replication of Anthropic's persona/emotion-vector methodology to extract steering vectors in Gemma on a consumer GPU, verified by targeted steering and activation patching.
- [AlponaGen dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/ar1tr0/alpona-gen): 13,000-image 1024x1024 synthetic dataset of Bengali folk art.
